description: Is this token safe to buy? Honeypot and sell-tax test, holder concentration, liquidity and locks, mint/freeze powers, proxy/upgradeable contract, with a 0-100 safety score and plain-English flags. ★ One of our best tools. Rug-pull and scam check for any token on Base, Solana, Ethereum, BNB, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism or Avalanche. Checks honeypot, buy/sell tax, mint/freeze authority, hidden owner, proxy, blacklist, holder concentration, locked liquidity, pool age and market data, then gives flags, a 0-100 safety score and a verdict. Use first for a quick verdict on whether one token (by contract address) is a scam or rug pull. Instead, use `token-report` ($0.10) for holders, whales, liquidity and news too. Answers may be cached for up to 10 minutes. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. In the free trial.

address.description: Token contract address (0x...) or Solana mint address.

chain.description: Blockchain: base, solana, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche.

name: token-safety

checksNotRun.description: Checks that couldn't run (data source blocked, empty or not covered).

contract.description: Raw contract findings from the scanner.

dataComplete.description: false when some checks couldn't run; see checksNotRun.

disclaimer.description: Limits of this answer; not financial, legal or security advice.

freshness.description: When each part was checked: security (the scanner; a saved answer is at most 10 minutes old) and market.

market.description: asOf/ageSeconds: the price; poolsAsOf/poolsAgeSeconds: liquidity, volume and pools (can be older when only the price could be refreshed).

liquidityKnown.description: False when only a price was available.

liquidityUsd.description: Total DEX liquidity across all pairs; null when unknown (only a price was available), never a false $0.

pairs.description: Number of DEX trading pairs; null when unknown.

poolsAsOf.description: Present when pool data is the last known (DEX sources busy): when it was fetched.

priceNative.description: Price in the pair's quote token.

noVerdict.description: True when the verdict is 'unknown' (not enough data to judge).

score.description: 100 = no issues found. null when any check couldn't run (see checksNotRun): then read the verdict and summary.

sources.description: Every source used, with saved answers marked and dated.

summary.description: One plain line to show a person: verdict, what's fine, main risks, what couldn't be checked.

verdictReason.description: Why: red flags found, which checks couldn't run, or insufficient data.

title: Check a token: is it a scam? ($0.02)
